purpose: A census of the request-header names that a real-IP library, a CDN or an ingress documents as carrying the client's address, run through the rule 'no Go file names a forwarded header other than X-Forwarded-For' (internal/fitnessrules/client_identity_corpus_test.go). Every name is run in both quote styles and in three Go contexts (a Get call, a header list copied into a slice, a constant), at internal/server/reader.go and at internal/server/clientaddr.go; every name that must fire is also run at a _test.go path, where the rule must stay quiet. expect: fire = the rule refuses the name; quiet = the rule leaves the name alone; hole = a client-identity name no pattern matches, pinned quiet, and whoever closes it flips the row to fire.
bounded_by: Names a person copies, by accident, from a real-IP library's header list or a CDN's or ingress's documentation: hyphen-separated, in any letter case, in double quotes or backticks. The shapes the rule matches: X-Forwarded alone or followed by anything but exactly -For; X-Real-IP; Forwarded and any name made of forwarded with a prefix other than a lone x or a suffix after a hyphen; and any name that ends in -ip, client-ip or socket-ip, with or without a trailing v4 or v6. Not bounded, and pinned as holes: a client-identity name that ends in none of those (X-Envoy-External-Address, CloudFront-Viewer-Address, Remote-Addr and the -Addr family), the same names spelled with underscores (the CGI form django-ipware reads, HTTP_X_FORWARDED), and a name built by concatenation or held in a constant defined elsewhere.

rows.name: X-Forwarded-For
rows.producer: every proxy; the one name internal/server/clientaddr.go reads

rows.name: x-forwarded-for
rows.producer: lower case spelling of the fenced name

rows.name: X-FORWARDED-FOR
rows.producer: upper case spelling of the fenced name

rows.name: x-forwarded
rows.producer: request-ip (lower case, as Node reads it)

rows.name: CF-PSEUDO-IPV4
rows.producer: upper case spelling of a versioned name

rows.name: cf-connecting-ipv6
rows.producer: lower case spelling of a versioned name

rows.name: Proxy-Client-IP
rows.producer: Apache AJP and Java servlet containers

rows.name: X-Forwarded-Proto
rows.producer: every proxy; scheme, not identity, but fenced here too

rows.name: X-Forwarded-Host
rows.producer: every proxy; host, not identity, but fenced here too

rows.name: Remote-Addr
rows.producer: django-ipware's REMOTE_ADDR, read as a header

rows.name: HTTP_X_FORWARDED
rows.producer: django-ipware's META key, CGI underscore form

rows.name: HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR
rows.producer: django-ipware's META key, CGI underscore form

rows.name: Cf-Ray
rows.producer: Cloudflare, a request id and not an address

rows.name: CF-IPCountry
rows.producer: Cloudflare, a country and not an address

rows.name: X-Amzn-Trace-Id
rows.producer: AWS load balancers, a trace id and not an address

rows.name: client-ip-address
rows.producer: a name that ends in address, not ip

rows.name: client-ipv6-prefix
rows.producer: a name that ends in prefix, not ip or ipv6
